emc-diffusion.query: ("extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma" OR "extra-skeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma" OR "extraskeletal myxoid") AND (diffusion OR "apparent diffusion" OR ADC OR DWI)

broader-myxoid-diffusion.query: (myxoid AND (sarcoma OR liposarcoma OR myxofibrosarcoma OR fibromyxoid)) AND ("apparent diffusion" OR diffusion-weighted OR ADC)

sarcoma-threshold-priorart.query: ("soft tissue" AND (tumor OR tumour)) AND (ADC OR "apparent diffusion") AND (myxoid OR threshold OR cutoff OR cut-off)
